author: subMedia
title: Eruptions in France
content:
FOR WEEKS, A GROWING MOVEMENT HAS BEEN SPREADING ACROSS FRANCE

ULTIMATELY SWELLING INTO A NATIONWIDE UPRISING.

THE UNREST HAS INVOLVED STRIKING FIREFIGHTERS,

INSURGENT HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS,

PUSHING BACK AGAINST THE VIOLENCE OF POLICE.

“Paris erupted again on Friday as thousands of students flooded the streets around Bastille.”

BETWEEN HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS, COLLEGE STUDENTS,

FIREFIGHTERS, SUBURBAN YOUTH, YELLOW VESTS & LABOUR UNIONS.

THE FRENCH GOVERNMENT HAS CONCEDED TO SOME OF THE STUDENTS’ DEMANDS

DEPLOYING 3,000 SUBSTITUTE TEACHERS & ANNOUNCING NEW EDUCATION FUNDING

IN AN ATTEMPT TO DIVIDE THE MOVEMENT.

A DAY OF ACTION IS PLANNED FOR OCT 17TH

THAT WILL BRING ALL SECTORS OF THE MOVEMENT TOGETHER.

“Students in Belgium’s French speaking region are also taken to the streets now.”

Love and rage to the barricades.
